name: Briclinks Africa PLC
source: CRON 20261014: Briclinks Africa Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), whole naira as printed. The filing prints two quarterly columns only, Apr-Jun 2026 and Jan-Mar 2026, so the H1 figures are the sum of those two printed columns. Each printed column ties internally, and the sums reproduce both identities: turnover less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit and gross profit less overheads equals the printed profit before taxation. The filing prints no income tax for the period, so no tax cell is written. | NGX filing library, Briclinks Africa Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGN, as printed). Cost of Sales is the printed charge of 358,623,267 (2024: 286,699,292) stored as a positive deduction. Operating Expenses is the printed Administrative Expenses line. Operating Profit (EBIT) is Gross Profit less Administrative Expenses. Net Finance Costs is Interest Payable and Similar Charges. Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the printed Profit on Ordinary Activities After Tax in both years.

periodAlignment.note: this statement and its counterpart cover different periods; pair them by period label, never by array index (see bot/statements.py::pkey)
